description:
Compare two visual states structurally (dHash, CLIP vector, JSON diff, layout delta) or two video trajectories (keyframe similarity, divergence point). Provide state_a_id/state_b_id for state comparison, or video_a_id/video_b_id for video trajectory comparison. Use compare_states instead of manage_snapshot when computing direct visual/structural deltas between two states rather than saving or restoring checkpoints.

Returns Hamming hash distance, cosine vector similarity, structural layout diff, and layout change flag.

state_a_id.description: ID of visual state A (state comparison mode)

state_b_id.description: ID of visual state B (state comparison mode)

name: compare_states
